trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Dharwad (Matrimonial Case No. 94/2023)
case_name: Smt Deepika W/O Shivaprakash Hiremath vs Shri Shivaprakash S/O Shadaxarayya

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Deepika W/O Shivaprakash Hiremath, wife

facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent are husband and wife who got married in 2020. Due to un-cordial relationship, they are living separately. Respondent filed petition for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. Petitioner seeks transfer of proceedings from Dharwad to Bengaluru.

legal_principles.principle: When a wife seeks transfer, the convenience of the wife needs to be considered.
legal_principles.held: The convenience of the wife must be looked into.
cited_cases: Sumita Singh Vs. Kumar Sanjay and another, (Year) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: The justice demands that the wife's inconvenience be considered when seeking transfer.
legal_principles.held: Justice demand that when the wife seeks transfer, convenience of the wife is to be looked and in the present circumstance, the wife is residing at Bengaluru and the travel distance between Bengaluru and Dharwad is around 450 Kms. which is overnight journey and it is highly inconvenient for the petitioner to travel all the way to attend the proceedings initiated by the husband at Dharwad.

outcome.final_order: Petition is allowed and the proceedings in Matrimonial Case No. 94/2023 pending on the file of the Principal Judge, Family Court, Dharwad are transferred to the Family Court, Bengaluru.
